title: Object Of Care Asset Scanning Party

cards.heading: Scanning Party overview
cards.description: In the Object of Care workshop, we organized a scanning party inspired by Sean Lee and Yvonne Felix’s prompt on the theme of “Object of Care.” Participants were invited to bring an object of care to scan and share the personal stories behind these objects.

title: 2025 South Korea 3D Asset for Story-telling Workshop

cards.heading: Workshop overview
cards.description:
Two SSX (Sari-Sari Xchange) workshops were held in South Korea, showcasing the development of the Sari-Sari Xchange Asset-Repository (SSXA), a growing collection of 3D digital assets aimed at increasing cultural diversity and representation in media arts. The workshops focused on addressing the lack of everyday, culturally specific objects in existing asset libraries, particularly those affecting marginalized communities.

The first workshop took place at Woosong University in Daejeon, engaging international students in a reflective discussion on the personal and cultural significance of objects they had brought from home. Participants explored themes of identity and community through storytelling and shared lived experiences, setting the groundwork for using the city as a creative XR sandbox for future projects.

The second workshop was part of the ISEA symposium in Seoul. It included a demonstration of the SSX team's 3D scanning and storytelling methodologies, discussions on copyright and digital authorship in the age of AI, and a presentation of outcomes from the initiative. Across both sessions, SSXA was positioned not only as a technical repository but also as a cultural archive that centers diasporic narratives, challenging monolithic representations of Asian identity.
